sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名前列的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学使命的一部分，旨在提升所有生物的生活质量。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Sustainability is...
sentences.zh: 可持续性是……

sentences.en: Sustainability is...
sentences.zh: 可持续性是……

sentences.en: Well, I think for a lot of people, sustainability is an abstract thing, and as such, it's hard to sort of engage on it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为对很多人来说，可持续性是一个抽象的概念，因此很难让人产生共鸣。

sentences.en: On the emotional level, it's really needed to push things forward.
sentences.zh: 在情感层面上，确实需要它来推动事物向前发展。

sentences.en: We want to inspire people rather than creating guilt trips or making them look at numbers.
sentences.zh: 我们希望激励人们，而不是制造负罪感或让他们盯着数字看。

sentences.en: Sustainability is something that can be powerful and experiential and impact your life.
sentences.zh: 可持续性是一种可以产生强大力量、带来亲身体验并影响你生活的事物。

sentences.en: My name is Anton Willis.
sentences.zh: 我叫安东·威利斯。

sentences.en: I'm a designer and part of a studio called Civil Twilight.
sentences.zh: 我是一名设计师，也是一家名为“文明黄昏”（Civil Twilight）工作室的成员。

sentences.en: Civil Twilight's flagship project is Lunar Resonant Streetlights.
sentences.zh: “文明黄昏”的旗舰项目是“月光感应路灯”。

sentences.en: These are streetlights that sense and respond to ambient moonlight.
sentences.zh: 这些路灯能够感知并响应环境中的月光。

sentences.en: So they dim and brighten in response to the lunar cycle.
sentences.zh: 它们会随着月相周期而变暗或变亮。

sentences.en: When the moon is full, they dim down to save energy.
sentences.zh: 当月圆时，它们会调暗亮度以节省能源。

sentences.en: It's both a way of saving energy and creating a new urban connection to the cycle of the moon.
sentences.zh: 这既是一种节能方式，也是一种建立城市与月球周期之间新联系的方式。

sentences.en: The project won the 2007 Metropolis Next Generation Design Competition partly because it took this huge design challenge of trying to curb energy use and added a bit of the poetic,
sentences.zh: 该项目赢得了2007年大都市下一代设计竞赛，部分原因在于它应对了抑制能源消耗这一巨大的设计挑战，并增添了一丝诗意，

sentences.en: a design that saves energy but also inspires and reconnects urban dwellers with one of the fundamental cycles of nature.
sentences.zh: 这种设计既能节能，又能激发灵感，让城市居民重新与自然的基本周期建立联系。

sentences.en: In most cities today, the level of light pollution is so high that we're really not aware of the stars or moonlight at all.
sentences.zh: 在当今大多数城市，光污染程度非常高，以至于我们根本察觉不到星星或月光。

sentences.en: You know, no one knows what phase of the moon it is on any given day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，没人知道任何一天是什么月相。

sentences.en: So we're looking for a way to really reconnect people to those kinds of cycles.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在寻找一种真正让人们重新与这些周期建立联系的方法。

sentences.en: Each individual light has a very sensitive photo sensor that picks up moonlight, cloud cover, atmospheric conditions.
sentences.zh: 每一盏灯都有一个非常灵敏的光传感器，可以捕捉月光、云层覆盖和大气状况。

sentences.en: So on the scale of a city, you could actually have really interesting phenomena.
sentences.zh: 因此，在城市规模上，你实际上可以看到非常有趣的现象。

sentences.en: If a cloud passed over the moon, you could sort of see a shimmering across the city reflecting the kind of cloud shadow.
sentences.zh: 如果云层飘过月亮，你可以看到城市中闪烁的光影，反映出云层的阴影。

sentences.en: We see it as a pretty amazing way to make cities as a whole more responsive and sort of more dynamic and more alive.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是一种非常了不起的方式，能让整个城市变得更具响应性、更具活力、更有生命力。

sentences.en: It turns out that in the early years of street lighting, both gas and electric, gas and electricity was really expensive, so they only turned them on when they needed to.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在早期路灯照明时期，无论是燃气还是电力，成本都非常昂贵，所以人们只在需要时才开启它们。

sentences.en: And they typically would not turn them on on full moonlit nights when it was clear out.
sentences.zh: 而且在天气晴朗的满月之夜，他们通常不会开灯。

sentences.en: People just had the understanding that that was enough light to see by in cities and it was a waste of energy to light on top of that.
sentences.zh: 人们当时就明白，在城市里这些光线足以照明，再额外开灯就是浪费能源。

sentences.en: And that really changed with the national grid electrification in the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 而这种情况在20世纪30年代国家电网电气化后发生了真正的改变。

sentences.en: When they actually needed a way to burn off excess energy at night when no one was using electricity in their homes.
sentences.zh: 当时他们确实需要一种方法来消耗夜间多余的能源，因为那时人们家中并不怎么用电。

sentences.en: And the streetlight grid actually began as a way to do that as much as a way to illuminate cities.
sentences.zh: 路灯电网的初衷，既是为了照亮城市，也是为了消耗这些多余的电力。

sentences.en: And since then, almost every city has to be illuminated very brightly, 24 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，几乎每个城市都必须全天24小时保持明亮的照明。

sentences.en: The standards for lighting that are in place come out of that period.
sentences.zh: 现行的照明标准正是源于那个时期。

sentences.en: So this is an effort to make a beautiful, energy-efficient version of a thing designed and used historically to burn energy on purpose.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一项旨在创造一种美观且节能的替代方案，来取代历史上那种为了消耗能源而设计的照明方式。

sentences.en: I think we've gotten used to talking about sustainability in terms of a lot of metrics and numbers and less about people's direct experience of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们已经习惯于用大量的指标和数字来谈论可持续性，而较少谈论人们对其的直接体验。

sentences.en: So we're looking at ways to really bring it to a tangible, personal, experiential level.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们正在寻找方法，将其提升到切实、个人化和体验性的层面。

sentences.en: We see ourselves as part of a stronger direction that the whole sustainability movement will go, we believe, in the coming years.
sentences.zh: 我们认为自己正处于整个可持续发展运动未来几年将要走向的更强劲方向的一部分。

sentences.en: So where's my friendly neighborhood moon-responsive streetlight?
sentences.zh: 那么，我那友好的邻里月光感应路灯在哪里呢？

sentences.en: Well, so far it only exists as a prototype.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止，它还只是一个原型。

sentences.en: So far.
sentences.zh: 目前为止。

sentences.en: MIT Labs are also prototyping a similar, in-spirit, indoor adaptive lighting system as a massive energy-saving technology,
sentences.zh: 麻省理工学院实验室也在开发一种精神内核相似的室内自适应照明系统，作为一种大规模节能技术，

sentences.en: but also as a way to make our working environments more comfortable, productive, and pleasing through using more natural and responsive light.
sentences.zh: 同时也是一种通过使用更自然、更具响应性的光线，让我们的工作环境更舒适、更高效、更令人愉悦的方式。

sentences.en: I think a lot of the current design discussion is about how to make design more relevant,
sentences.zh: 我认为当前很多设计讨论都在探讨如何让设计更具现实意义，

sentences.en: how to make it part of these processes that really shape the world, the economics, the government,
sentences.zh: 如何让设计参与到真正塑造世界的进程中，比如经济、政府，

sentences.en: all of the sort of processes that we don't think of being designed or having a relationship to design.
sentences.zh: 以及所有那些我们认为与设计无关或没有关联的进程。

sentences.en: Climate change is a design problem.
sentences.zh: 气候变化是一个设计问题。

sentences.en: You know, the national debt is a design problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，国债也是一个设计问题。

sentences.en: All of these things are design problems in different ways if you expand the scope of how you think about it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 如果你稍微扩展一下思考范围，所有这些在不同程度上都是设计问题。

sentences.en: Our challenge as designers is really to expand that scope and to become part of bigger discussions.
sentences.zh: 作为设计师，我们的挑战确实是扩展这一范围，并参与到更大的讨论中去。

sentences.en: And sustainability is...
sentences.zh: 而可持续性是……

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到Lunar的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects, San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是KALW、美国建筑师协会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的一个项目。

sentences.en: Find out more at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
